## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky25

### Memory and glob optimizations

- [#21](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/21): intern unresolved symlink destination strings.
- [#23](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/23): share sorted field names in schemaless structs.
- [#24](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/24): compare literal glob segments without compiling regular expressions.
- [#25](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/25): compare and hash providers using shared field names and values.
- [#26](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/26): remove provider creation locations except for DefaultInfo.
- [#27](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/27): share paths in runfiles symlink entries.
- [#28](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/28): store package targets in sorted lists and adapt the fork's toolchain lookup.
- [#29](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/29): cache Starlark builtin ancestors.
- [#30](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/30): share frozen rule and macro attribute metadata.
- [#31](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/31): store small schemaful provider values inline.
- [#32](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/32): represent repeatable native options with a private subtype.

Shared prerequisites from #23/#25 and #26/#31 are included once. No combined performance measurement was run.

### Upstream 9.3 update

Rebased onto upstream `release-9.3.0` at [f8093718b9](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/f8093718b95cf777244533c898cc657fd30fc7d3). The update adds:

- Parallel rewinding of action templates ([#31081](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31081)).
- Canonical labels for MODULE.bazel flag aliases ([#31076](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31076)).
- System IPv6 address preferences in startup JVM arguments ([#31079](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31079)).
- Action-cache invalidation when remote cache endpoints or instances change ([#30986](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/30986)).
- Remote input materialization with overlay execution roots ([#31055](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31055)).
- Avoiding invalidation of materialized external repository files ([#31048](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31048)).
- The `repository_ctx.patch(directory)` argument ([#31016](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31016)).
- Preservation of empty sandbox inputs when refreshing a modified directory ([#31059](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31059)).

Earlier fork backports now supplied by upstream were deduplicated: empty sandbox input tracking, skipping remote output analysis under `--nobuild`, run-transition invalidation, disk-cache deletion races, and directory-entry invalidation.

[#31122](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31122) (#21),
[#31124](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31124) (#23),

### Validation

Sixteen complete test targets passed on the rebased source, covering providers, Starlark, configuration rules, packages, toolchains, runfiles, symlinks, remote caching, and sandboxing. The publication script passed 21 mocked checks. Before the rebase, the full VFS suite reproduced the exact same 45 permission-denial assertion failures as unchanged release 25; the focused glob and ignored-directory tests passed. No combined performance benchmark was run.

### Release publication

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before publication. The immutable release includes SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
